integrity: All 4096 initial states and 120 spatial graph automorphisms were exhaustively checked. Two independently implemented transition maps agree on the complete phase-portrait census. No external independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact finite-state theorem concerns only the twelve-vertex icosahedral graph with synchronous binary open-neighbor strict majority. No claim of a formula for larger polyhedral families; unindexed equivalent tabulations may exist.
title: Isolated hemispherical equilibria and seven oscillatory symmetry types in icosahedral majority dynamics
